title: Driver/Truck Project Intake & Roster Convergence Final Verification
verdictReason: Persistence writes across TruckRepository, DriverRepository, and ProjectCarrierRosterRepository are executed sequentially as unbatched promises rather than inside a single atomic Firestore runTransaction, exposing a PARTIAL_STATE_RISK upon middle-of-sequence failures.

remediationRequired.task: Wrap multi-table writes in driverTruckIntake.service.ts inside a canonical Firestore runTransaction block.
